Textes blancs, contours marqués, fond no: White text, strong outlines, black background
8 bits, environ un tiers plus léger que: 8-bit, about a third smaller than JPEG at the same quality. Recent browsers and software.

AVIF : sRGB seulement (pas de profil ICC: AVIF: sRGB only (no ICC profile in the file).

Photos probablement floues, les moins ne: Probably blurry photos, least sharp first. A photo with an intentionally blurred background counts as sharp if its subject is.

Texture, logo ou autre photo (PNG transp: Texture, logo or another photo (transparent PNG accepted)

stable-diffusion.cpp, téléchargé par Lum: stable-diffusion.cpp, downloaded by Luminux: no server or Python, graphics card through Vulkan (AMD, NVIDIA, Intel), processor as fallback. The recommended model (SD 1.5 inpainting) runs with 4 GB of video memory.

Désactivé avec le moteur local : demande: Disabled with the local engine: needs ComfyUI.
Peins sur le calque pour l'effacer, bord: Paint on the layer to erase it, soft edge; Alt to bring back what was erased.
Le fond de l'image du calque est retiré: The layer image background is removed; only its main subject remains.
Met le calque dans l'ambiance de la phot: Puts the layer in the photo's mood: tint, haze, whites; its own brightness is kept.
Photo et calques aplatis dans un nouveau: Photo and layers flattened into a new file (Pictures/Luminux), opened right away: eraser, retouching and adjustments then apply to everything.
Fais glisser le calque sur la photo pour: Drag the layer on the photo to place it; the round handle above rotates it (Shift: 15° steps).
Ajouter un dossier à la bibliothèque: Add a folder to the library
Peins l'objet (« Retirer » ou Alt pour e: Paint the object (“Remove” or Alt to take part away), then “Erase”. It takes a few seconds.
Paint over the object (“Remove” or Alt to take part away), then “Erase”. Plain fill: for sky, walls, skin; instant.
Entoure l'objet (« Retirer » ou Alt pour: Outline the object (“Remove” or Alt to remove an area), then “Erase”. Several areas are allowed.
Peins la zone (« Retirer » ou Alt pour e: Paint the area (“Remove” or Alt to take part away), then “Generate”. Strength < 1 keeps the original shape (except with an inpainting model).
Clic sur une petite tache (poussière, bo: Click a small spot (dust, blemish): it is replaced by the area in the blue dotted circle, picked automatically. Drag that circle to copy from elsewhere. Only the markers of the last spot and the hovered one are shown. [ and ]: size.
SDXL : 8 Go de mémoire vidéo conseillés,: SDXL: 8 GB of video memory recommended, slower generation. If the download fails, “Other model…” accepts the same file copied from a ComfyUI server (models/checkpoints folder).
Huit réglages au plus : supprimes-en un: Eight adjustments at most: delete one to add another.

Peins sur la photo avec « Ajouter », cor: Paint on the photo with “Add”, correct with “Remove” (or Alt). [ and ]: size. Right-drag: move the view.
Pour un RAW ou une retouche dans un autr: For a RAW or editing in another program; the file is twice as large.
Remet l'opacité et les curseurs de ce ré: Resets this adjustment's opacity and sliders (the area is kept)
Lossless: much larger than a JPEG.
Sans perte, pour l'impression ou un autr: Lossless, for printing or another editor.

LaMa efface, puis le moteur de Générer r: LaMa erases, then the Generate engine does a half-strength pass for a more natural texture. Slower: a few tens of seconds per group of objects. Nothing to type.
Précise : chaque groupe de personnes est: Precise: each group of people is handled separately, and a long crowd in 2 or 3 slices. Sharper, but 2 to 3 times slower.
